about.title: Heritage in Every Single Detail
about.p1: From the vibrant heart of Cairo, Hamid Afandi brings the timeless coffee tradition to life with passion, craftsmanship, and authenticity. Our story began with a simple vision: to honor the complex rituals of Egyptian brewing while embracing the refinements of modern roasting.
about.p2: We source only the finest beans from ethical farmers across the coffee belt, ensuring every bag tells a story of origin, resilience, and unparalleled flavor.

immersive.title: The Coffee Experience
immersive.subtitle: More than just a drink, it's a sensory journey. We source the finest beans, roast with care, and craft each cup to deliver a rich and unforgettable experience.
immersive.stat1Sub: Directly from the farm to our roastery.
immersive.stat2Sub: Small batches for maximum flavor profile.

heritage.storyP1: Since 1975, Hamid Afandi has been a beacon of Egyptian coffee culture. Our journey began in the bustling heart of Mansoura, bringing together the finest ethically sourced beans with time-honored roasting techniques, crafting a legacy of rich, aromatic blends.
heritage.storyP2: We invite you to experience the tradition.

aboutPage.title: A Legacy Crafted Since 1975
aboutPage.subtitle: Some stories are written with words. Ours has always been written with coffee.

chapters.title: Where It All Began
chapters.body: Hamid Afandi started with one simple promise: coffee people can trust, enjoy, and come back to every single day. Nearly five decades later, that promise hasn't changed.

chapters.title: Every Step, In Our Hands
chapters.body: We never outsourced quality. Every bean is hand-selected, roasted in our own roastery, and ground by us — to keep its natural aroma, balanced body, and true character.

chapters.title: A Thousand Small Details
chapters.body: Behind every great cup are details most people never notice. Patience in every batch, experience in every roast — that's the difference between ordinary coffee and coffee made with purpose.

chapters.title: More Than a Drink
chapters.body: A new morning, a long talk with friends, a quiet pause in a busy day. Coffee is part of life's moments — and we're proud to be in yours.

chapters.title: Heritage Meets Tomorrow
chapters.body: We've refined our methods and embraced new techniques, without ever trading away authenticity. Select with care, roast with precision, grind it ourselves — same as day one.

aboutPage.quote: Coffee has never been simply a beverage. It is part of everyday life.
aboutPage.storySignatureTagline: From Our Roastery to Your Cup... A Tradition Perfected Since 1975.
aboutPage.value1Desc: We partner directly with farmers who share our values of sustainability and fair trade.
aboutPage.value2Desc: Small-batch roasting in Cairo preserves the nuance of every origin we source.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Every product design and brewing method honors centuries of Egyptian coffee culture.
aboutPage.value4Desc: Our branches are gathering places — spaces for conversation, culture, and connection.
aboutPage.followBody: Behind-the-scenes roasting, new blends, and life at our branch — follow along on social media.
